title: Kannukkul Nilavu
desc: Gautham, a man with a neurological condition, comes to Pondicherry looking for a woman named Gayathri. Nevertheless, he meets Hema, who realises his condition and decides to help him recover.

title: Pistha
desc: The arrogant daughter of a rich businessman marries a man to inherit her grandfather's property but soon, her life changes when she finds out that her husband is a fugitive.

title: Koodi Vazhnthal Kodi Nanmai
desc: Thangaraj and his wife, Meenakshi, take care of his brothers, Krishnan and Sivaraman. However, when the brothers get married, conflicts grow among them.

title: Pandavar Bhoomi
desc: Dhanasekar hires an engineer to rebuild his ancestral house. When he falls in love with Dhanasekar's niece, Dhanasekar narrates his family's past, which changes his mind to sacrifice his love.

title: Motta Siva Ketta Siva
desc: Shivakumar, a corrupt police officer, joins GK, a local politician, in his immoral activities. However, when GK's brother kills his best friend, he decides to turn over a new leaf.
